trades.audit:
GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: A-
GRADE_noahsaint: B+
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Jonathon Brooks is a 23‑year‑old RB for Carolina in his third NFL season, while Chris Rodriguez Jr. is a 27‑year‑old RB for Jacksonville in his fourth season. The younger age and potential upside of Brooks give Dayton a longer‑term asset, whereas Rodriguez offers more immediate, proven production. Consequently, Dayton receives the higher dynasty value.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: B-
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B+
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup received Patrick Mahomes, Chuba Hubbard, 2028 Round 1. Worthy of my Chuba received Anthony Richardson Sr., 2027 Round 1, 2027 Round 1, 2028 Round 3. On the assets exchanged, Worthy of my Chuba comes out ahead.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: A-
GRADE_Chicken Soup: B
WINNER: Fire Haslam Into The Sun
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam received quarterback Joe Burrow (CIN, age 29, 6 completed seasons) and third‑round picks in 2027 and 2029, providing immediate starter value and future draft capital. Chicken Soup received tight end Brock Bowers (LV, age 23, 2 completed seasons), a younger player with upside but less immediate impact and lower positional value.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: A-
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: MaxWeese25
ANALYSIS:
Bryce Young (QB, CAR, 25, 3 seasons) provides a young, potentially long‑term starter, while Sam Darnold (QB, SEA, 29, 8 seasons) is an older, likely backup quarterback. The 2028 Round 1 pick received by Syracuse outweighs the 2028 Round 3 pick received by MaxWeese, but Young’s age and upside exceed Darnold’s value, giving MaxWeese the better overall return.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: B+
GRADE_spearson22: A-
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup acquired a 2029 first‑round draft pick, which will be made three seasons from now. spearson22 received a 2028 first‑round draft pick, occurring two seasons from now, giving it a marginally higher present value. Consequently, spearson22 obtained the more valuable asset in this trade.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: A-
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B-
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Dayton acquired two tight ends—24‑year‑old AJ Barner (SEA, 2 completed seasons) and 29‑year‑old T.J. Hockenson (MIN, 7 completed seasons)—plus a 2029 fourth‑round pick. Justin received three future mid‑round selections (2027 third, 2028 fourth, 2029 fourth). The immediate roster impact of two proven‑age tight ends outweighs the value of three later picks, giving Dayton the superior return.

GRADE_T-Mac Attack: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Jordan Mason (RB, MIN, age 27, 4 completed seasons) and a 2027 4th‑round pick provide modest immediate depth but limited upside. Justin Jefferfather receives a 2027 3rd‑round pick plus a 2027 4th‑round pick, offering higher draft capital and greater future flexibility. Consequently, Justin’s side captured more dynasty value.

GRADE_noahsaint: B
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: A-
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Josh Downs is a 25‑year‑old wide receiver with three completed seasons for Kansas City, offering limited immediate upside in a dynasty context. A 2027 second‑round pick represents a high‑value, controllable asset that could become a top‑tier player in the next draft cycle. Therefore, Justin Jefferfather’s acquisition of the future second‑rounder provides greater long‑term value than Noahsaint’s receipt of Downs.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C-
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B+
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
Dayton Degenerates received two 2027 second‑round selections, which are one‑year‑away assets with uncertain future value. All Gas No Bench acquired D'Andre Swift, a 27‑year‑old running back with six completed NFL seasons for Chicago, providing immediate proven production. In a dynasty context, a veteran RB of Swift’s profile outweighs two near‑future second‑round picks, giving All Gas No Bench the superior return.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: C+
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
Emanuel Wilson is a 27‑year‑old RB for Seattle with three completed seasons. The 2028 third‑round pick represents a draft asset roughly two years out and carries typical mid‑round upside. In dynasty terms, a known RB with NFL experience generally provides more immediate and tangible value than a future mid‑round selection, giving All Gas No Bench the advantage.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: C+
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse received veteran WR Amon‑Ra St. Brown (DET, 27, 5 seasons) plus a 2028 4th‑round and a 2027 3rd‑round pick. Justin received RB De'Von Achane (MIA, 25, 3 seasons) and higher 2027 1st‑ and 2nd‑round picks. The combination of a younger back and two early‑round selections provides more long‑term dynasty upside, giving Justin the advantage.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: B
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: C
WINNER: MaxWeese25
ANALYSIS:
Tre Tucker is a 25‑year‑old wide receiver for the Las Vegas Raiders with three completed NFL seasons. The return for Justin Jefferfather consists of a 2028 third‑round and a 2028 fourth‑round draft pick, both roughly two years out and low‑round selections. In a dynasty context, a known three‑year‑veteran WR generally provides more immediate and tangible value than two low‑round future picks, giving MaxWeese the advantage.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: C+
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam Into The Sun acquired RB Quinshon Judkins (CLE, 23, 1 season), rookie RB Jadarian Price (SEA, 23, 0 seasons), and a 2028 second‑round pick. Syracuse Sandstorms received RB De'Von Achane (MIA, 25, 3 seasons) along with a 2027 second‑round and a 2029 third‑round pick. The proven RB and the two higher‑value picks give Syracuse a clear dynasty advantage.

GRADE_noahsaint: C-
GRADE_spearson22: B+
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
spearson22 acquired a 2026 third‑round pick and an additional 2026 fourth‑round pick, giving them two draft assets. noahsaint received only a single 2026 third‑round pick, providing less future value. The extra fourth‑round selection tilts the trade in favor of spearson22.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: D
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse receives two 2026 second‑round picks, giving them twice the draft capital of All Gas No Bench, which only gets a single 2026 second‑rounder. The extra pick provides significantly more future roster flexibility and value in a dynasty context. Therefore Syracuse clearly obtains the superior return.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: B-
GRADE_T-Mac Attack: B+
WINNER: T-Mac Attack
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam received a 2026 second‑round and a 2028 second‑round pick, giving them two mid‑round assets, one immediate and one two years out. T‑Mac Attack secured a 2026 first‑round pick, which carries higher immediate upside than any single second‑rounder. Consequently, T‑Mac Attack obtained the superior dynasty value.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: D
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Deebo Samuel Sr. is a 30‑year‑old wide receiver with seven completed seasons, offering limited future upside in a dynasty context. The 2027 third‑round pick represents a future asset with potential to develop into a starter. Consequently, the pick provides more dynasty value than the aging WR.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: C+
GRADE_Mr texas: B+
WINNER: Mr texas
ANALYSIS:
MaxWeese25 receives a 2026 first‑round and a 2026 second‑round pick, which are valuable future assets but lack immediate roster impact. Mr texas receives those same two picks shifted one year later (2027 first‑round) plus a 2026 third‑round pick and three veteran players (Hunter Henry, David Montgomery, Michael Pittman Jr.) who, despite age, still provide proven production. The combination of an extra high pick and three established contributors outweighs the two earlier picks, giving Mr texas the superior side.

GRADE_Mr texas: C
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Kenny Gainwell is a 27‑year‑old RB with five completed seasons, offering limited upside in a dynasty context. Syracuse receives two first‑round picks (2026, 2027) versus Mr texas’s single first‑round (2026) and a third‑round (2028) plus the veteran RB, giving Syracuse a clear advantage in future roster building.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A
GRADE_spearson22: C+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse received a 2026 first‑round pick and a 2028 second‑round pick, both future assets that can be used to draft or trade for young talent. spearson22 received WR Courtland Sutton (31, 8 seasons, DEN) and RB Rico Dowdle (28, 6 seasons, PIT), both veteran players with limited upside. The future first‑rounder alone outweighs the two aging veterans, giving Syracuse the clear dynasty advantage.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: C+
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
De'Von Achane is a 25‑year‑old RB with three completed NFL seasons, and the 2027 third‑round pick is one round lower than the 2027 second‑round pick received by All Gas No Bench. DeVonta Smith is a 28‑year‑old WR with five completed NFL seasons, paired with a higher‑valued second‑round pick. The combination of a higher draft slot and a veteran WR gives All Gas No Bench a slight edge in dynasty value.
